newsitem.title: FRANCE: TENNIS-PLAY RESUMES AT FRENCH OPEN.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-PLAY RESUMES AT FRENCH OPEN.

text.p: Play resumed at the French Open on Monday after rain had interrupted proceedings for 40 minutes.

Chile's Marcelo Rios was trailing Morocco's Hicham Arazi by two sets to one when the weather halted play for the first time in the tournament with the pair level at 2-2 in the fourth set of their fourth-round match.
The other remaining men's singles encounter between Australians Pat Rafter and Mark Woodforde was also in a fourth set, with Rafter leading 6-2 5-7 6-1 3-1 when the rain began.
